subject: Friendly reminder about the shared project folder
text: Hi, since we are in the same class, I hope this week is going well, and I know we are all balancing several deadlines at the moment. I am sending a brief reminder because I noticed that several of our case-study drafts are still not uploaded to the shared folder, and the practical concern is that the final version may not compile correctly if any section is missing. Could you please check whether your assigned pages are present and, if not, add them by Thursday evening so we have time to review the whole document together? I also realized that the formatting template may have been changed after some people downloaded it, so please confirm you are using the version dated last Monday. That small detail could affect the page numbers and references. If you have already completed your part, thank you very much, and it may simply be a viewing permission issue on my side; in that case, let me know quickly so I can fix access. I appreciate everyone keeping the project moving smoothly, and if there is any obstacle preventing you from uploading your material, please share it in the group chat early enough that we can adjust. I understand schedules are tight, so I am not trying to add pressure, only to avoid a last-minute scramble when the library access ends later that week. Thank you for your patience, and please let me know if you need the checklist or the backup copy of the instructions. Thanks,
